title: Meta: create the Minds Aligned business portfolio
_note: Meta's create-app wizard needs a business portfolio and offers no skip when the account has none. A free, unverified portfolio is enough to create the app; do not start Business Verification. The create form was not reachable by URL on 2026-11-04 (business.facebook.com/create redirects home), so this step is centered text.

steps.instruction: Meta needs a business portfolio before it will create the app. Click the account name at the top left, choose Create a business portfolio, and enter Minds Aligned LLC, your name and mw@mike-wolf.com. Click Submit (or Create). Do not start Business Verification.
